description: A full-cache temporary is counted as a per-forward-token temporary.
trigger: Estimate an attention component with an attached quantized cache and more than one forward token.
expected_behavior: Count the full-capacity K/V reconstruction pair once per call, separately from query-token-dependent activations.
actual_behavior: CacheLayer_quant.overhead_size already covers the whole cache. Attention adds it to overhead_to_split, so initial_split multiplies it by the token count again before prorating. Conversely, overhead_per_device is documented per token but is charged once without a token multiplier.

verification.description: For the example cache, checked that the 4 MiB reconstruction pair is charged as 32 MiB at eight forward tokens on one device.
verification.limits: The arithmetic isolates the cache term and is not a peak-VRAM measurement.

introductions.rationale: Adds the full-cache reconstruction estimate as split overhead and applies a forward-token multiplier to it.

finding.description: Changing the attention split unit leaves the inherited token multiplier on full-cache scratch intact.
finding.trigger: Collect an attention record with an attached quantized cache, directly or via a containing module, then estimate it for more than one forward token.
finding.expected_behavior: Charge the full-size K/V reconstruction pair once per call and scale only token-dependent activations with token count.
finding.actual_behavior: Attention puts the full-cache pair in overhead_to_split, and the planner multiplies it by the forward-token count before prorating. Conversely, the replicated overhead field is documented per token but charged once.

verification.description: Isolated the cache term: 1,024 cache positions, eight heads, head width 128 and two bytes per element give a 4 MiB K/V pair, counted as 32 MiB at eight forward tokens.
verification.limits: This is estimate arithmetic, not peak VRAM or a live model-loading path.

observations.scope_note: The source still passes the full cache-pair scratch into the query-token-scaled estimate. No memory measurement.
